title: Building a 2D adventure game with a hungry seagull in the Embarcadero.
author: SubstantialEnd7112
selftext:
Using AI to build this game really got me from concept to an actual thing I could play really fast,

  
But it can be quite a struggle at times with backgrounds, interaction details and walk cycles. Especially animal walk cycles.

  
I do think it's really cool that I can have the craziest ideas and just implement them really fast though. Like what if we had a pidgeon gang into the game that sends you on little food smuggle missions, and you have to avoid getting caught by the cops. Or racing other seagulls in the sky, or planning a massive heist to steal a clam chowder sourdough bowl.
